blocks.text:
Transfer to the Cayo district. Visit the Actun Tunichil Muknal, meaning 'Cave of the Stone Sepulcher– one of the most impressive caves in the Maya lowlands. First, you'll hike for 45 minutes through dense jungle to the Tapir Mountain Nature Reserve, crossing three streams along the way, while admiring the flora and fauna of the jungle. Next, you'll reach this amazing cave system, which consists of chambers, and you'll enter the cathedral-like chamber (300 by 50 meters), where ancient sacrificial ceremonies once took place.

In the evening, transfer from Cayo to Belize City, where you'll take a water taxi to San Pedro on Ambergris Caye (1.5 hours).

Ambergris Caye, an island surrounded by palm fringes, is located 58 km north of Belize City. The island stretches 40 kilometers in length and is only 1,600 meters wide. You can leisurely walk from one coast to the other!

With its colorful sandy beaches, lagoons, mangrove forests, tropical savanna, and turquoise coastal waters, all under the hot sun, the island offers a true tropical paradise.
